channel.title: 2026-11 on Sujith Quintelier
channel.description: Recent content in 2026-11 on Sujith Quintelier

item.title: security: ARTEX abuse expands as cybercriminals target financial sector
item.description:
Microsoft reports that in October 2026 the financially motivated threat actor Storm-3358 started targeting financial-sector organizations using the agentic AI offensive framework ARTEX.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Copilot code review: API management and review overview updates
item.description:
GitHub Copilot code review settings can now be managed via REST and GraphQL APIs across enterprise, organization, repository, and user scopes. The review overview comment has also been made more compact.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Copilot impact dashboard adds chat and VS Code agent usage
item.description:
GitHub Copilot Impact dashboard’s Agent adoption chart now includes Copilot Chat and the VS Code Agents window, expanding coverage to nine Copilot experiences. This lets admins view engagement across those additional surfaces in the dashboard.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot weekly releases — November 2
item.description:
GitHub Copilot added support for JetBrains Air and Xcode’s coding assistant, and shipped updates for managing pull requests, settings, and agent sessions. The post also mentions an agent merge setup update in the GitHub Copilot app.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.107
item.description:
Release v1.0.107 adds many CLI, terminal, sandbox, MCP, model-picker, and session-management fixes. Notable changes include inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, a unified /settings dashboard with global search, and numerous corrections for Windows, Unicode, control-character handling, resumable sessions, and authentication flows.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: @GitHub in Slack and Teams is generally available and more
item.description:
@GitHub in Slack and Teams is now generally available. It lets users investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes, and open pull requests directly from conversations.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: commandline: The check that catches agent failures can also train them
item.description:
The post covers three ThinkingBox topics: broader model evaluations, the cost of making runs more dependable, and using reinforcement learning with terminal-state rewards. It also notes that the same check used to catch agent failures can be used as a training signal.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog

item.title: copilot-cli: 1.0.106
item.description:
Release v1.0.106 adds inline image support in Rex terminals, a new /code command, unified /settings/dashboard navigation, and several session/agent management improvements. It also includes many fixes for Windows, MCP/LSP/sandbox behavior, prompt editing, terminal rendering, and help/docs accuracy.

  • Source: GitHub Copilot CLI releases

item.title: github: Usage metrics API adds code review details and addressed rate
item.description:
GitHub’s enterprise and organization repository-level Copilot usage metrics now include code review outcome data. The repos-1-day report gains a new copilot_code_review object with counts for feedback handling, including an addressed rate.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now identifies users who are missing client telemetry or are using IDE/extension versions below the usage metrics minimums. It adds new per-user fields to expose these gaps.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: Threat actors use agentic AI tooling to find and abuse exposed secrets
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence observed threat actors using the agentic offensive security framework ARTEX to search GitHub for exposed OAuth application secrets. Compromised OAuth applications were then used to carry out authenticated actions inside affected organizations’ tenants.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Front Door TLS key exchange policy with post-quantum support
item.description:
Azure Front Door now offers configurable TLS key exchange policies, including hybrid post-quantum key exchange. This lets you balance cryptographic readiness with client compatibility requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: ai: Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is generally available
item.description:
The Microsoft Foundry extension for Azure Developer CLI is now generally available. It lets you set up, test, evaluate, and deploy hosted agents while keeping agent and deployment configuration with your code.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: dotnet: Help Shape the Future of .NET: Take the 2026 .NET Developer Survey
item.description:
Microsoft is asking .NET developers to complete the 2026 .NET Developer Survey to share experience, surface common challenges, and inform future .NET investment priorities. The survey is expected to take about 15 minutes.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: dotnet: Modernize your .NET apps for Windows Arm64 with GitHub Copilot
item.description:
Microsoft announced guidance for using GitHub Copilot’s upgrade agent to modernize .NET apps for Windows Arm64, covering blocker identification, migration planning, and code changes. The post is a .NET Blog entry focused on the upgrade workflow.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway
item.description:
WAF Insights for Azure Application Gateway Web Application Firewall is now generally available. The feature adds built-in dashboards in the WAF policy that combine logs and metrics for investigation.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: New investments to reduce on-premises security risk
item.description:
Microsoft announced a new on-premises security initiative that combines guidance, migration support, and product investments to reduce security risk in on-prem environments.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: ​​​​What’s new in Microsoft Security: November 2026
item.description:
Microsoft Security’s November 2026 update focuses on AI agent security, least privilege, threat protection, and exposure management. The post is a high-level roundup of security feature updates and product improvements.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: security: Email threat landscape: Q3 2026 trends and insights
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence reported a sharp rise in email-based phishing activity in Q3 2026, while QR code phishing declined. The post also noted a rebound in CAPTCHA-gated phishing and highlighted risks from malicious messages spoofing familiar business-service sender domains and security override behavior.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Secret scanning upgrades detectors, adds SpaceX as partner
item.description:
GitHub updated secret scanning by adding SpaceX as a new partner and introducing detection for starlink_public_api_v2_secret. It also upgraded multiple existing detectors, including Alibaba, AWS, Google, OpenVSX, and Pydantic Services.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: ai: Bring Agentic Coding On-Device with Foundry Local
item.description:
Microsoft says Foundry Local now supports agentic coding directly on developer hardware. The post announces local on-device use of the Qwen3-8-27B model for this workflow.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: ai: What’s new in Microsoft Foundry | October 2026
item.description:
October 2026 Microsoft Foundry updates include a Copilot harness preview, general availability for browser automation and hosted-agent resilience, a Decisions API, and SDK updates with chapter-linked Handoff demos. The post also points readers to Microsoft Ignite viewing on November 17-20.

  • Source: Microsoft AI Foundry Blog

item.title: github: New pull request overview page in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has introduced a new pull request overview page in public preview. It is intended to make it easier to see what is blocking a long pull request without scrolling through extensive comments and timeline events.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.4 improves accuracy and query metadata
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.4 was released with accuracy improvements across several queries and updates to query metadata. The changelog post does not include further technical detail in the provided excerpt.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s coding assistant
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is now available in Xcode’s built-in coding assistant as a public preview. The integration lets users access Copilot directly within the native Xcode workflow.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Database for PostgreSQL stable REST API version 2026-10-01
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server REST API version 2026-10-01 is now generally available. The release adds support for maintenance management, immutable backups, and multi-tenant encryption.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Generally Available: Route maps for Azure Route Server
item.description:
Route maps for Azure Route Server are now generally available in the Azure public cloud. They add fine-grained control over inbound and outbound routing across hybrid connections.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Firewall IPv6 now supports application rules
item.description:
Azure Firewall IPv6 is now in public preview for application rules, adding layer 7 filtering for IPv6 HTTP and HTTPS traffic. This extends application-level controls to IPv6 and dual-stack deployments.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Multi-disk crash-consistent VM restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra Disks on VMs with SCSI disk controller
item.description:
Azure VM public preview adds multi-disk crash-consistent restore points for Premium SSD v2 and Ultra data disks on VMs using SCSI disk controllers. It supports agent-less capture of crash-consistent restore points.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: vscode: Visual Studio Code 1.145 (Insiders)
item.description:
The provided content does not include the release notes for Visual Studio Code 1.145 (Insiders); it only contains a short prompt to read the full article. No feature or bug-fix details can be extracted from this text.

  • Source: VS Code Updates and Blog

item.title: visualstudio: Keep learning, keep building! Make the most of VSLive! with your Visual Studio Subscription
item.description:
The post promotes VSLive! as a learning event for developers and notes that Visual Studio Subscription holders can use it to get focused technical training, hands-on experience, and expert guidance.

  • Source: Visual Studio Blog

item.title: github: BYOK and enterprise custom models in the Copilot usage API
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now separates bring-your-own-key (BYOK) usage from Copilot-hosted model usage. It also reports on enterprise custom models.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: JWT validation for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports centralized JWT validation in public preview through the AuthPolicy custom resource. It can validate token signature, issuer, lifetime, and configured audience using signing keys from a trusted HTTP source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Private ingress for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports private frontends in public preview. These frontends are reachable only through approved Azure Private Link private endpoints, keeping internal, shared, and cross-cluster traffic on private networking.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Dependabot version updates support Agent Package Manager
item.description:
Dependabot version updates now support Agent Package Manager (APM), allowing automated pull requests to keep AI agent skills, prompts, and instructions current.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Advanced capacity insights are now available in Azure Storage Discovery
item.description:
Azure Storage Discovery is adding advanced capacity insights in public preview. The update expands visibility into storage usage with insights such as access patterns, data age, storage tiers, object size distribution, and retention-related data.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: dotnet: Delivering Skills in NuGet packages
item.description:
The post says agent skills can be packaged and delivered through NuGet packages to provide models with up-to-date library documentation.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Extend immutability for PITR backups for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
item.description:
Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance now support extending immutability for PITR backups in public preview. This lets you lock backup retention to the configured PITR retention period instead of only the default 7 days.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Enhanced Azure Site Recovery support for VMSS Flex
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery now supports an enhanced disaster recovery experience for Virtual Machine Scale Sets with Flexible orchestration. The update improves target configuration and end-to-end recovery workflows, including failover and reprotection.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Fake-download campaign uses trojanized installers to deliver monetization payloads
item.description:
Microsoft Threat Intelligence describes a fake-download campaign that uses trojanized Inno installers to deliver monetization payloads. The post includes detection and investigation guidance covering the full installer session.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: dotnet: Get Ready for .NET Conf 2026!
item.description:
The post announces that .NET Conf 2026 starts in one week, running November 10–13. It will include the launch of .NET 11, two days of Microsoft sessions, and two days of Community Days.

  • Source: .NET

item.title: security: Microsoft named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI Agent Management Platforms
item.description:
Microsoft says Gartner named it a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Magic Quadrant for AI Agent Management Platforms. The provided text does not include product changes, technical details, or release notes.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: Look up a resource’s cost center with the GitHub REST API
item.description:
GitHub REST API now supports looking up the cost center for a user, organization, repository, or enterprise team. This replaces the previous need to enumerate all cost centers to find the matching one.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air
item.description:
GitHub Copilot is now available in JetBrains Air. The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and lets you delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results in the IDE.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: CodeQL 2.27.3 adds Python 3.15 features and JSON data extensions
item.description:
CodeQL 2.27.3 has been released. The update adds support for new Python 3.15 language features and JSON data extensions.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Dependabot now supports Python 3.15
item.description:
Dependabot now supports Python 3.15, so projects can upgrade to that version and continue receiving dependency update alerts and pull requests. The support is available to all github.com users.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Desktop adds short-lived authentication tokens
item.description:
GitHub Desktop 3.6.10+ now supports short-lived, automatically refreshing authentication tokens for eligible accounts. This reduces the time a leaked token remains usable.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: security: What exploited vulnerabilities have in common: A data-driven analysis of real-world attacks
item.description:
Microsoft Security Blog says real-world exploitation is concentrated in a small subset of CVEs, and defenders should prioritize vulnerabilities by exploitation likelihood, exposure, and potential blast radius. The post presents a data-driven analysis of exploited vulnerabilities.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: On-prem NAS share discovery and assessment are now available using Azure Migrate
item.description:
Azure Migrate added public preview support for discovering and assessing on-premises NAS shares. The feature helps plan migrations of Dell PowerScale (OneFS) and NetApp ONTAP storage to Azure.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: OT security in Microsoft Defender for IoT
item.description:
Microsoft plans to deprecate the OT security component of Microsoft Defender for IoT. The service will be fully deprecated in October 2029 after a three-year transition period.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Change from virtual network integration to a private endpoint capable network configuration in Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server
item.description:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server now supports changing existing VNet-integrated servers from delegated-subnet networking to a private endpoint-capable network configuration. This gives more flexibility in network design for existing workloads.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Fluid Relay
item.description:
Azure Fluid Relay will be retired on February 2, 2027. After that date, the service will be unavailable and workloads depending on it may be disrupted; the Fluid Framework remains available as open source.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Storage Actions adds automatic task updates, execution controls, and case-sensitive matching
item.description:
Azure Storage Actions now automatically propagates task definition updates, adds more execution control, and supports case-sensitive matching for automated data operations across Azure Blob and Data Lake Storage.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Restart databases in Azure SQL DB via the Azure portal
item.description:
Azure SQL Database now supports restarting or failing over databases directly in the Azure portal. This applies to single databases, Hyperscale databases, and databases in elastic pools.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Geo-Replication on partitioned namespaces for Azure Service Bus Premium
item.description:
Geo-Replication for partitioned Azure Service Bus Premium namespaces is now generally available. It lets you use partitioning for throughput while replicating messages and metadata to a secondary Azure region for resilience.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery for Azure Local
item.description:
Azure Site Recovery support for Azure Local is now generally available. It lets customers protect supported Windows and Linux virtual machines by replicating them for disaster recovery.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Security risk assessments include repository protection status
item.description:
GitHub’s code security risk assessment and secret risk assessment now indicate whether findings are in protected or unprotected repositories. This helps organizations see where to extend security coverage.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: pull_request_target blocked by default December 2
item.description:
Starting December 2, 2026, GitHub Actions will block pull_request_target events by default in all public repositories unless an applicable Actions event policy explicitly allows them. The enforcement date was changed from a previous schedule.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: commandline: Nine engineers, 1,211 pull requests in a day: Lessons from building Copilot Cowork
item.description:
Microsoft describes a case study from building Copilot Cowork, including a live migration of the runtime from Python to Rust. The article frames the migration as an example of the engineering practices used while shipping the system.

  • Source: Microsoft Command Line Blog
